Other Refractor parallels for the set include Prism, Negative, Magenta (/399), Teal (/299), Yellow (/275), Aqua (/199), Blue (/150), Green (/99), Purple (/75), Gold (/50), Orange (/25), Black (/10), and Red (/5). # 2025-26 Topps Chrome Basketball Checklist, Team Sets and Details 2025-26 Basketball Card Sets, Checklists, Checklists-New, New By Andrew Harner - December 17, 2025 December 17, 2025 9 When you click on links to various merchants on this site, like eBay, and make a purchase, this can result in this site earning a commission. ### Jump to the 2025-26 Topps Chrome Basketball checklist and team set lists 2025-26 Topps Chrome Basketball marks the company’s first licensed standalone Chrome offering since 2008-09, and collectors will get plenty of variety once the product hits store shelves. Image Box types for the product will include hobby, jumbo, mega, Fanatics mega, blaster, hanger, Breaker’s Delight, and First Day Issue. Topps will also release a complete factory set and a Sapphire version of the product. Hobby boxes will include one autograph, while jumbos will have three. ## 2025-26 Topps Chrome Basketball Checklist Details If you are new to the Topps basketball scene, Topps Chrome serves as a premium upgrade to the 2025-26 Topps flagship basketball set printed on a chromium stock. Topps announced the base set will run 299 cards, featuring veterans, rookies, and legends. Image All of those cards will be covered by more than four dozen parallels — which are detailed in our guide — including traditional Refractors and the coveted Frozenfractors (/-5) and Superfractors (1/1). Topps has selected 50 players for base image variations, which have exclusive Speckle Refractors. Image Other Refractor parallels for the set include Prism, Negative, Magenta (/399), Teal (/299), Yellow (/275), Aqua (/199), Blue (/150), Green (/99), Purple (/75), Gold (/50), Orange (/25), Black (/10), and Red (/5). Collectors will also search for Wave, Blue Wave (/150), Green Wave (/99), Purple Wave (/75), Gold Wave (/50), Orange Wave (/25), Black Wave (/10), and Red Wave (/5) Refractors. Additional parallels include Pulsar Refractors (Hanger box-exclusives), SkyLight Refractors (Fanatics mega box exclusives), X-Fractors (Mega box exclusives) and Geometric Refractors (Breaker’s Delight-exclusives) in Gold (/50), Orange (/25), Black (/10), Red (/5), and White (/2). First Day Issue will be a Jumbo-Exclusive, giving the concept its return for the first time since the 2007-08 Stadium Club set. Blaster boxes will feature Red, White, and Blue parallels. Image Packaging for mega boxes declared the boxes would include Blue X-Fractors, but Silver X-Fractors were produced for the product. After receiving feedback from collectors, Topps decided to print Blue X-Fractors and opened an exchange program, allowing collectors to exchange Silver X-Fractors for Blue X-Fractors on a 1-to-1 basis. To learn more about the exchange, which expires on June 30, please visit this Topps Ripped article. Image ## Autographs Topps revitalized the brand in 2023-24 and 2024-25 as an unlicensed product, and Chrome will soon make its triumphant return with full licensing now that Topps has regained a deal with the NBA. ## When ripping into packs of 2025-26 Topps Chrome Update Basketball cards, some collectors have come across individual cards that don’t look like the rest of the cards or one of the product’s parallels. The checklist includes the first 90 veterans on the base checklist and 10 select rookies, but collectors will not see these cards very often (as an example, a Denim Tears card falls once every 303 hobby boxes or 1:26 cases). Pack odds for all formats include: * Hobby – 1:6,054 * Jumbo – 1:2,415 * Delight – 1:201 * Value – 1:17,433 * Mega – 1:109,866 * Fanatics – 1:8,774 * * * ## Image Variations Image Variations have become a common feature of Topps Chrome products for many years, and it’s very easy for collectors to tell if they’ve found one from Topps Chrome Update. Not only do the cards have alternate photographs — posed shots, just as was the case in the flagship Chrome product — but the cards are also printed with a Speckle foil pattern exclusive to the image variants. The first 40 veterans on the checklist and 10 select rookies make an appearance. Image Shop for Image Variations on eBay While not easy to find, the Image Variations aren’t the toughest pull either. They land 1:150 hobby packs (or 1:8 boxes), so collectors can expect at least one per case. Pack odds for other box types include: * Jumbo – 1:68 * Delight – 1:48 * Value – 1:324 * Mega – 1:223 * Fanatics – 1:213 In addition to the base versions, collectors can also find six levels of parallels for each player. Starting with Green Speckle (/99) and dropping to Superfractors (1/1), collectors will be looking to complete a second rainbow for their favorite player with a variation. Image: 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball Go Hard or Go Home Dwyane Wade # 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball Checklist, Team Set Lists and Details 2018-19 Basketball Card Sets, Checklists By Ryan Cracknell - November 20, 2018 November 20, 2018 2 When you click on links to various merchants on this site, like eBay, and make a purchase, this can result in this site earning a commission. ### Jump to the 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball checklist and team set lists. If you collect basketball and you’re a fan of all things bright, you’re probably familiar with Prizm. 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball has no shortage of shine. It has a broad rainbow spectrum, several inserts, autographs and a variety of configurations. ### Chasing the 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball Base Set Rainbow 2018-19 Panini Prizm Basketball is anchored by a 300-card chromium base set. Veterans and first-year players are mixed together. Atsuko Nishida Stadio evolutivo Pokémon Fase 2 Si evolve da Poliwhirl Nome della carta Politoed Tipo Acqua Punti Salute 110 Debolezza ×2 Resistenza Nessuna Costo di ritirata Image: Image: Espansione Skyridge Rarità Numero della carta H23/H32 Espansione giapponese Saketa daichi Rarità giapponese Numero della carta giapponese 031/088 Espansione Skyridge Rarità Numero della carta 25/144 Espansione giapponese Saketa daichi Rarità giapponese Numero della carta giapponese 030/088 Per informazioni sulla specie di Pokémon, si veda Politoed. Politoed è una carta Pokémon Fase 2 di tipo Acqua. Fa parte dell'espansione Skyridge. ## Testo Crescita Improvvisa きゅうせいちょう Assegna quante carte Energia Base vuoi dalla tua mano a Politoed. Ranabalzo かえるとび 30+ Lancia una moneta. Se ece testa, questo attacco infligge 30 danni più altri 20 danni. Spruzza Energia エネスプラッシュ 70 Sposta 2 carte Energia assegnate a Politoed su I o 2 dei tuoi Pokémon in Panchina (puoi assegnare le carte Energia a un solo Pokémon o a due diversi). Se non hai Pokémon in Panchina,ignora questo effetto. ## Dati e-Reader L'ID della carta della stampa Olografica è E-62. L'ID della carta della stampa Non Olografica è E-62-#. Sulla stampa Non Olografica, la striscia corta contiene informazioni Pokédex e un breve riepilogo della carta e informazioni sul contenuto della striscia lunga. La specie, l'altezza e il peso sono presenti sulla stampa Olografica. ### Dati Pokédex Acqua AcquaPolitoed - Pokémon Rana N. 186 Altezza 1,1 m Peso 33,9 kg Dati Pokédex I Poliwag e i Poliwhirl si riuniscono subito se odono il verso rauco che emette con la gola. なきごえが ひびきわたると あちこちから ニョロモや ニョロゾたちが あつまってくる。 ### Construction: Action La striscia lunga contiene i dati della mappa per l'applicazione Construction: Action. ## Curiosità ### Origine I dati Pokédex e-Reader della versione inglese di questa carta provengono da Pokémon Cristallo, mentre quelli della versione giapponese provengono da Pokémon Oro. Macchinario Scientifico ([Nota 2])

Skyridge è la terza e ultima espansione principale di carte della Serie e-Card del Gioco di Carte Collezionabili Pokémon. L'espansione continua a includere i Pokémon Cristallini e la seconda generazione.

Sinossi

Sempre in vantaggio sui tuoi avversari!

L'espansione Skyridge™ di Pokémon® ha ben 6 Pokémon dotati del nuovo potere Poké-Body di tipo Cristallo che gli permette di usare qualsiasi tipo di Energia con cui lavorare. Questa eccitante espansion
[…]
Come quanto successo per Aquapolis, anche Skyridge ha un numero di raccolta delle carte separato per le carte Rare Holo. Skyridge è stato l'ultimo set del GCC Pokémon prodotto da Wizards of the Coast, nonostante avesse pianificato altri due set (Legendary Collection 2 e Jamboree) il cui rilascio era in programma al momento dell'annuncio di Skyridge. È anche l'ultima espansione ad includere Kadabra.

Sposta 2 carte Energia assegnate a Politoed su I o 2 dei tuoi Pokémon in Panchina (puoi assegnare le carte Energia a un solo Pokémon o a due diversi). Se non hai Pokémon in Panchina,ignora questo effetto.

Dati e-Reader

L'ID della carta della stampa Olografica è E-62. L'ID della carta della stampa Non Olografica è E-62-#. La specie, l'altezza e il peso sono presenti sulla stampa Olografica.
